study type: secondary analysis of a multicenter retrospective cohort
exposure: Delivery policies: expectant management until 35 weeks vs. immediate delivery ≥34 weeks
outcome: Composite neonatal outcome (neonatal sepsis, antibiotic administration >72 hours after delivery, respiratory support)
Neonatal antibiotic administration >72 hours after delivery
cohort: 259 pregnant women with preterm prelabor rupture of membranes (PPROM) ≥34 weeks
finding: Obese women with PPROM ≥34 weeks had higher odds of adverse neonatal respiratory and infectious outcomes compared to non-obese women.
mod_finding: While the abstract notes that mode of delivery was included as a variable in their statistical model, there is no mention of specific findings related to mode of delivery.
